findings: Demo hardcoded dark theme in light mode — All .demo-* color values are hardcoded dark hex constants with no [data-theme="light"] overrides. Visitors who switch to light mode see a dark phone island with no surrounding context. Add a [data-theme="light"] .demo-wrapper background adjustment, or add copy to the section header clarifying this is always a dark-mode preview.

Description field silently ignored — The <input class="demo-desc-input"> has no id and is never read by the submit handler. A user who types a description and submits sees it silently dropped. Either wire it into the toast message or add placeholder="(not used in demo)" to set expectations.

Keyword substring misfires in Peso chat — demoGetReply matches keys like 'how', 'track', 'doing' anywhere in the lowercased message string. 'Somehow' triggers the monthly-summary reply; 'backtrack' triggers the budget-check reply. Low-stakes given the fallback is honest, but easy to fix by anchoring keys with word boundaries or switching to exact-phrase matching.
